title: Universal Free Cam Mobile And PC No Key
features:
made this free cam script cause i couldn't find one that actually worked well on both pc and mobile lol

what it does:
- pc: wasd to move, mouse to look around, q/e to fly up/down
- mobile: joystick on screen + swipe to look around
- toggle button or press P on pc
- ur character literally can't move while it's on, so no more accidentally walking off somewhere lol
- little intro screen when it loads

how to use:
1. copy script
2. paste in executor, execute while in game
3. press P or tap the button to turn it on/off

made by 0nlyymikii, hope it works for you guys

comments.text: 6.5/10 script works pretty well but moving around with mouse isnt working and the W and S keys are inverted; holding down W moves you backward and S moves you forward. Works fine though
